title: Fix: 3 test_misc census checks lost their prose anchors after thin-body migrations
action: REPRO (already red): node packages/bee/tests/test_misc.mjs => 114 passed, 3 failed — census checks (a) 'AO14 execution-worker class ... no canonical prose still asserts tiny/small in-session solo implementation', (b) 'native Codex empty waits ... ordered, mutation-resistant contract on every writable surface', (c) 'worktree dispatch contract: eligibility, protected attestation, consistency-only identity, typed integration halts'. Root cause: skill-token-diet thin-body migrations + parallel-default doctrine flips moved/reworded the asserted prose out of the locations/wording the census greps. FIX with MEANING PRESERVED, choosing per check: (1) if the contract prose still exists in the new home (a references/ file), update the census check's search locations/patterns in packages/bee/tests/test_misc.mjs to the new home — the check keeps asserting the same contract; (2) if a load-bearing contract phrase was genuinely LOST in migration, restore it in the owning skill's references/ file (never a body over budget) AND keep the census pointing at it. NEVER delete or weaken a census check — its job is exactly to catch this. End: test_misc 117 passed, 0 failed. If any skills/ reference file is touched, fences must stay green; regen DEFERRED (wave-barrier ack).
